name: C# Apps & Games
shortDescription: Unity game-jam games, including Entitled Goose Game (UW Game Jam Fall 2024) and Bandwidth (UW Winter 2025 jam).
description:
Unity games made mostly at game jams, plus earlier C# experiments.

- **Entitled Goose Game** (UW Game Jam Fall 2024, 48 hours, team of six): play a magical goose that combines four elements (rock, wet, wind, hot) into spells in a real-time fight. Kevin: programming and design. [Play](https://matthewz80.itch.io/entitled-goose-game)
- **Bandwidth** (UW Winter 2025 Game Jam, 72 hours, team game): an action game about an IT new hire at "Tasla". [Play](https://matthewz80.itch.io/bandwidth)
- **Happy Santa Go Time** (Bear Hacks 2022): a short horror experience made to learn Unity. [Play](https://anonabento.itch.io/happy-santa-go-time)
- **PROJECT: Apartment**: an 11-day showcase demo. [Play](https://anonabento.itch.io/project-apartment)

Across these: C# gameplay logic in Unity for 2D and 3D games (physics, colliders, AI logic), finite state machines for animation and character behaviour, and Git for team collaboration. Separately, a C# app using Emgu OpenCV as the vision part of a larger alarm system.

Won **Best Overall** at UWGDC Game Jam Fall 2024.
award: Best Overall, UWGDC Game Jam Fall 2024
